audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Trundle zero stages out of seven in a matchup he wins 60.13% of the time over 153 games — flagged in the packet defects and confirmed on disk (Skill/Riven/Riven/Skill/Skill/Riven/Riven).
audit.why: A 60% matchup that reads as a loss at every single stage tells the player the wrong thing before the game starts. Riven genuinely owns levels 2-3; she does not own the item stages against a champion with no kill pressure on her and no sustain of her own.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Riven / Riven / Skill / Trundle / Trundle / Trundle in both layers, with levels 6, first item and 2+ items rewritten so the text carries the flip instead of contradicting it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blade of the Exile was never named and its cooldown never used, so 'her burst window' read as permanent.
audit.why: Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60s. At rank 1 that is two minutes between reloads, and outside it her damage ceiling drops sharply — which is exactly the window Trundle's Frozen Domain attrition is built for.
audit.corrected: The 120s rank-1 cooldown written into spikes[2], whys[5], mid and phases[5].why as the concrete fight-selection rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never named a Riven ability (packet defect), described a level-1 'Q dash into W stun' she cannot have at level 1, attributed the knock-back to the wrong place, and called Chomp an attack-SPEED steal. Riven has no resource, so there is no mana punish either.
audit.why: At level 1 Riven has exactly one ability. Telling a player she opens with a dash-into-stun at level 1 makes him give up a lane phase he could be contesting.
audit.corrected: Broken Wings (13s, third cast knocks back), Ki Burst (11/10/9/8/7s), Valor (10/9/8/7/6s shield-and-step) and Blade of the Exile all named with cooldowns; the level-1 line rewritten around the single ability she actually has; the sap corrected to attack damage.

audit.why: Valor is the shield that eats your opening Chomp and it is 10s at rank 1. Chomp is 3.5s. Biting into a fresh Valor wastes the trade; biting the beat after it wins one.
audit.corrected: 'Bite after Valor, Pillar the exit' written into whys[2], early, phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid paragraph split behaviour by rank tier — 'Riven players in Emerald do not extend'.
audit.why: Point 12 of the audit forbids splitting common mistakes by elo, and the observation is true of Riven players generally, not of one tier.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as a behaviour claim with no tier attached, and turned into an instruction: punish the reload, not the combo.

edits.before: Riven's first Q dash into W stun hits before you can establish Frozen Domain — she front-loads her combo at level 1 before your W or E are online.
edits.after: At level 1 she has only Broken Wings (13s), but the third cast knocks you back — she front-loads that before Frozen Domain or Pillar of Ice exist.

edits.before: Riven's full three-Q dash chain with E shield absorbs your early Chomp trades and lets her reset damage on the exit dash.
edits.after: Broken Wings' three dashes plus Valor's shield (10s at rank 1) soak your first Chomp and carry her out before King's Tribute pays.

edits.before: Subjugate gives you a fighting chance — drain her Armor mid-fight and your W domain keeps you alive, but her burst window inside the combo still threatens to end you before the drain registers.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile is 120s at rank 1 and hands her bonus AD — Chomp saps AD every 3.5s, so biting inside her ultimate shaves the exact stat she just spent two minutes of cooldown on.

edits.before: At two completed items the matchup becomes a genuine skill fight — your Frozen Domain sustain and stacked Subjugate resistances offset her combo damage if the lane is even.
edits.after: Two items and the attrition is yours: Frozen Domain healing plus the stolen resists outlast a combo she can only reload every 120 seconds at rank 1, and she has no sustain.

edits.before: Land Pillar of Ice to cut off her escape dash and deny her E repositioning after a combo
edits.after: Pillar of Ice on her exit once Valor (10s at rank 1) is spent, so the combo has no way out

edits.before: Use E shield to absorb your Chomp hit and reset her attack rotation away from Pillar range
edits.after: Let Valor's shield eat the first Chomp, then reset the rotation outside Pillar of Ice range

edits.before: Riven dashes into W stun at level 1 before your Frozen Domain is placed — she wins the first trade free with E shield absorbing your Chomp hit.
edits.after: At level 1 she has one ability and so do you — Broken Wings out-ranges Chomp's 300 and its third cast knocks you back, so contest last hits, not her.

edits.before: Her Q2 and W stun arrive before your own W or E are skilled — two-point Riven out-trades two-point Trundle at this window every time.
edits.after: Ki Burst (11s at rank 1) joins Broken Wings at 2 — the stun carries the whole dash chain and out-trades a two-point Trundle. Give the wave.

edits.before: Full three-Q dash chain plus E shield means she can enter your Frozen Domain, take a Chomp hit, and exit before King's Tribute healing swings the trade — she wins clean.
edits.after: Three Broken Wings dashes plus Valor (10s at rank 1) let her enter your Frozen Domain, eat one Chomp on the shield, and leave before King's Tribute swings it.

edits.before: At level 6 Subjugate gives you the drain, but her burst inside one combo rotation can end the fight before the drain fully registers — she still edges the raw 1v1 if she plays the all-in correctly.
edits.after: Subjugate arrives with Blade of the Exile, and the two point opposite ways: her ultimate is bonus attack damage, and Chomp saps attack damage. Bite through it, drain her resists, and the burst window shuts.

edits.before: First item Riven has a powerspike that keeps her burst above your sustain threshold — she still controls trade timing by using E shield to absorb your Chomp and resetting on the exit dash.
edits.after: Her first item raises the ceiling on one combo, but Blade of the Exile is 120s at rank 1 — fight in the two minutes she is without it and Frozen Domain healing outlasts the rest of her kit.

edits.before: At two completed items your Subjugate-stacked Armor plus Iceborn Gauntlet Chomp sustain makes you extremely difficult to kill in extended duels — neither player has a clean kill window and skill decides it.
edits.after: At two items the stolen resists and Frozen Domain healing make you very hard to kill in a long duel, and Riven has no sustain at all — if her combo fails to kill you, Pillar of Ice takes the exit and you win the attrition.

edits.before: At level 1 Riven walks up and Q dashes into your face before Frozen Domain is placed — your Q Chomp AS steal is real but she absorbs the first Chomp window with her E shield and dashes back out before King's Tribute can heal you. Play the wave at maximum Q range, drop W immediately if she Q-dashes in, and never chase her third Q because her W stun is waiting at the end of it. Your goal at levels 1-3 is to not die and to land one clean Pillar of Ice when she overextends off the third dash — the terrain cuts her escape route and is the only way you win a trade early.
edits.after: At level 1 Riven walks up and Broken Wings (13s) dashes into your face before Frozen Domain exists — Chomp's AD sap is real, but Valor's shield eats the first bite and she is out before King's Tribute heals you. Hold the wave at Chomp's 300 range, drop W the moment she starts the dash chain, and never chase the third cast: it knocks you back, and Ki Burst (11s at rank 1) is waiting behind it. Through levels 1-3 your job is to not die and to land one clean Pillar of Ice after Valor is spent — the terrain takes her exit, and that is the only early trade you win.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 she has her full dash chain and enough AD to burst you inside one rotation if you are caught without Frozen Domain active — respect the all-in window and always have W placed before she starts Q1. You can win extended fights if you pillar her exit path and keep standing in the ice, but Riven players in Emerald do not extend; they combo and back off. At level 6 Subjugate is your first real leverage: drain her Armor the moment she engages and let your W healing keep you alive through the burst — she cannot trade efficiently once you have stolen a meaningful chunk of her defenses. Land Pillar on her W-stun recovery dash to deny the reset.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 she has the full dash chain and enough AD to burst you in one rotation if you are caught without Frozen Domain down — always place W before she starts the first Broken Wings cast. You win extended fights if you Pillar her exit and keep standing in the ice, but Riven players do not extend; they combo and back off, so punish the reload rather than the combo itself. At level 6 Subjugate is your leverage and it points straight at her ultimate: Blade of the Exile grants bonus attack damage, Chomp saps attack damage every 3.5 seconds, and the resist drain lands on top of that. Engage once Valor (10s at rank 1) has already been spent.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst (Stun): matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Riven Ki Burst: Short-range AoE stun — her engage CC. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Ki Burst (W): 11/10/9/8/7s. Her stun, and the glue in the dash chain. - Valor (E): 10/9/8/7/6s. A step plus a shield that eats your first Chomp — bite after it, then Pillar the exit.

edits.before: W down at your feet turns short trades your way: move speed, attack speed, and healing on your own terrain. Trade only inside the zone.
edits.after: Ki Burst (11s at rank 1) lands at 2 and the stun carries her whole dash chain. Frozen Domain cannot out-heal that yet — hold the wave.

edits.before: Pillar closes the kit — use it behind Riven to deny disengage, or between you and Ki Burst (Stun) to break her pattern.
edits.after: Valor's shield (10s at rank 1) eats your first Chomp. Bite in the beat after she spends it, then Pillar of Ice on her exit.

edits.before: Subjugate online — the 1v1 is yours into almost anyone the moment Riven commits. R early in the all-in so the drained resists count for the whole fight.
edits.after: Subjugate lands with her Blade of the Exile — hers is bonus AD, and Chomp saps AD. Bite through the ult, drain the resists, and the window shuts.

edits.before: Trinity Force is the duel spike — Spellblade procs off every Chomp. Force Riven to answer you in the side lane.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile is 120s at rank 1. Fight her in the minutes she has no ultimate and your healing wins.

edits.before: With two items you out-duel Riven whenever R is up. The only loss condition left is fighting with Subjugate down — track it like she tracks Ki Burst (Stun).
edits.after: With two items you out-duel Riven whenever Subjugate is up. The only loss condition left is fighting with it down — track your own R like she tracks Ki Burst.
